ALGEBRAIC CONSTRUCTIONS
IN THE CATEGORY OF VECTOR BUNDLES
by
CONSTANTIN M. ARCUS¸
Abstract
In this paper we present the category of generalized Lie algebroids. Important
results (a theorem of Maurer-Cartan type, theorems of Cartan type,...) emphasize
the importance and the utility of the objects of this new category.
2000 Mathematics Subject Classiﬁcation: 00A69, 58A15, 58B34.
Keywords: vector bundle, (generalized) Lie algebroid, interior diﬀerential system,
exterior diﬀerential calculus, exterior diﬀerential system.
